newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CSOB cuts prime rate by 80 bps to 14.85 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech CSOB cuts prime rate by 80 bps to 14.85 pct.

text.p: Prague-based Ceskoslovenska Obchodni Banka a.s. (CSOB) said on Tuesday that from August 6 it would cut its prime rate by 0.8 percentage points to 14.85 percent.

The base rate for credits up to one year will be cut by 0.75 percentage points to 15.25 percent and on credits from two-three years by 0.15 percentage points to 14.1 percent, CSOB said in a statement.
The moves follow a general downtrend in rates on the Czech interbank markets.
